semantics: Realization Layer (ADR 0021 decision 1) — the tool-neutral Core invariants BOUND to Claude-native mechanics (decision 2). Host laws shared by every role live in HOST_DIALECTS.claude (src/core/dialects.ts); this file adds only role-specific bindings.

invariantBindings.binding: Phases 1–8 run as exhaustive Grep/Read sweeps before any finding is judged; static analysers run in Bash (eslint, bandit).

invariantBindings.invariant: Evidence-based findings only: every claim cites file, line, and snippet.
invariantBindings.binding: The report template requires File/Snippet/Risk/Remediation lines per finding; Read supplies the cited code.

invariantBindings.invariant: Findings are recommendations only; the reviewer never executes or modifies.
invariantBindings.binding: The tool allowlist carries no write tools — Read/Grep/Glob only; Bash is restricted to read-only analysers by policy.

invariantBindings.invariant: At most two peer exchanges per specialist pair and one directed question per peer per planning round.
invariantBindings.binding: Under Agent Teams (opt-in) peer exchange uses SendMessage; otherwise the budget is spent through the orchestrator's session.
